question: Should OpenClaw runtime Docker/Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain sandbox-only?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible, but the choice changes documented container behavior across Docker, Podman, generated setup files, and sandbox path semantics, so automation should not pick the policy by itself.

options.title: Expose a runtime alias
options.body: Add a consistent `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof.

options.title: Keep sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Leave runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Defer behind DooD sandbox work
options.body: Resolve the adjacent Docker-outside-of-Docker sandbox path contract first, then apply one workspace path policy to runtime and sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Expose a runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a consistent `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across Dockerfile, Docker setup, Podman launcher, and adjacent Docker workspace setup decisions.
